name: title-12

name: subtitle-12
text: Preventive controls are backed by audit evidence and explicit production-hardening requirements.
textPreview: Preventive controls are backed by audit evidence and explicit production-hardening requirements.

name: security-list
text:
PASSWORDS
password_hash / password_verify

DATABASE
PDO prepared statements + InnoDB constraints

REQUESTS
Session rotation + CSRF validation

ACCESS
Server-side roles and ownership predicates

FILES
MIME and size allow-list + random names

OUTPUT
Contextual escaping + restrictive CSP
textPreview: PASSWORDS | password_hash / password_verify |  | DATABASE | PDO prepared statements + InnoDB constraints |  | REQUESTS | Session rotation...

text:
Speaker: Novithan
Explain the defense layers and distinguish the completed academic controls from future TLS, WAF, managed secrets, backups and penetration testing.

[Sources]
- https://www.php.net/manual/en/function.password-hash.php
- https://www.php.net/manual/en/pdo.prepare.php
- https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authentication_Cheat_Sheet.html
- https://www.justice.gov.za/legislation/acts/2013-004.pdf
[/Sources]
